name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq: evol
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq: evolve 5 qubits with 3 layers of random rotations U, apply U^dagger, and verify the system returns to |0...0> with probability 1; then perturb one angle by 0.13 and report the echo decay. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
